name: Dragon Den - Weights and Raid Times
teaser: A simple mod that allows you to change Weight of items (can use complex means) and change Raid Time per map.
description_html:
Overview

What it does

  • Change raid time per map
  • Change item weight with global, per parent, or per item rules
  • Optional whitelist and blacklist to target specific items
Features

  • Raid Time
    Set minutes per map.

  • Weight Changer

    • Global percent applies to all items when no other match
    • Per parent percent by item parent id or parent name
    • Per item percent by exact item id or name
    • Whitelist limits edits to listed items
    • Blacklist excludes specific items and overrides all

  • Rule priority
    Per item over per parent
    Per parent over global
    Blacklist over everything

Installation

Unpack the zip and drop the user folder into your SPTarkov root.

(Use 7Zip Here)

Install demo video credit to Drakia:

How to Use

Edit the config file in DragonDen-WeightsAndRaidTimer\config The config contains comments.

  • Toggle features on or off
  • Set minutes per map for raid length
  • Set weight percents
  • Add parent ids or names for category edits
  • Add specific item ids or names for overrides
  • Use the whitelist to restrict edits only to listed items
  • Use the blacklist to protect items from any change
Compatibility
  • Can be used with SVM but should be loaded after it, and not using the same settings.
  • Has to be loaded after all mods that add items or change raid settings.
Known Issues
  • Adjusting Raid Times too large can cause issues.
  • Other than that, none that I know of.
Credits
  • Drakia for the install video
What is Dragon Den

Dragon Den is my twist on Tarkov. It is where cuteness, edgyness, and weirdness collide while staying believable.

  • Traders with their own quirks and attitude
  • Custom items and quests that feel fresh
  • Backpacks, armor, facewear and headwear with personality
  • Odd creations that should not exist but still fit right in

No weapons, just everything else that makes Tarkov less boring.
